title: ci(docker-publish): wait until npm serves the CLI's install tree before the image build
body:
Fixes #25613

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

On a release, the Docker image job starts about a minute after `changeset publish` returns. At that point npm can still answer 404 for some of the fixed group's tarballs. On 18.1.0 that made the image build fail: `npm install -g @objectstack/cli@18.1.0` got E404 on `spec-18.1.0.tgz` (release run 40078805767, job 120834761830). The same URL answered 200 a few minutes later.

## What changed

`.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml` gets a new step, `Wait until npm serves the CLI's install tree`, between `Validate version input` and the image build. Its inline Node script:

- walks `@objectstack/cli@VERSION`'s `@objectstack/*` dependency tree on the registry, starting from the CLI's own manifest and following `dependencies` (each range's operator is stripped, because the group is lockstep);
- for every package, needs both the version manifest and a `HEAD` on its `dist.tarball` to answer 200;
- reads a newly found dependency at once and waits only on a miss, backing off 5 s → 10 s → … → 60 s, bounded at 10 minutes;
- on a timeout, writes one `::error::` per package still missing and exits 1;
- treats a network error as a miss, so it is retried like a 404.

Both callers get it: `workflow_call` from `release.yml` and `workflow_dispatch`. A rebuild of a version that is already out passes in seconds.

## Local verification

These runs used the extracted script, with Node 22 against the live registry:

| case | result |
| :-- | :-- |
| `VERSION=18.1.0` | `npm serves @objectstack/cli@18.1.0 and 54 @objectstack/* dependencies.` exit 0, about 20 s |
| `VERSION=18.0.0` | the same line for 18.0.0, exit 0 |
| `VERSION=99.0.0`, deadline shortened to 20 s | waits 5 s, then 10 s, then `::error::npm does not serve @objectstack/cli@99.0.0 …`, exit 1 |

- The workflow parses as YAML, and the step order reads back as written.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 39 derived families, 39 run, all exit 0.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: GOVERNED, tier H (`.github/workflows/**`), 66 changed lines.

## Acceptance notes

- **Tier H.** This PR needs an approval from one of GOVERNED_APPROVERS before the seat readies and lands it.
- **Recovery of the 18.1.0 image** is out of scope here. The card names two ways: a re-run of the failed job, or the next landing's release-integrity backfill.
- **Claim.** The seat's claim on #25613 is comment 6385843623, and it names this branch.
- **`skip-changeset`.** No published package is touched; the PR changes only a workflow.
